description: This file defines the NettyResponseWriter class, which extends ResponseWriter and handles sending HTTP responses over a Netty channel, including socket connection management and logging.

classes.name: NettyResponseWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for writing HTTP responses to a Netty channel, managing connection closure, delays, and logging.

methods.name: NettyResponseWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the response writer with configuration, logger, channel context, and scheduler.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response and closes the socket if necessary.

methods.name: writeAndCloseSocket
methods.description: Handles writing the response to the channel and closing the socket based on connection options and configuration.

methods.name: disconnectAndCloseChannel
methods.description: Disconnects and closes the channel, with logging of success or failure.
